dedupe_keys.name: a global dataset of unified road centrelines for 2073 coastal urban areas using voronoi tessellation

description: A Global Dataset of Unified Road Centrelines for 2073 Coastal Urban Areas Using Voronoi Tessellation is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Tao Yang et al. Over 40% of the world’s population lives within 100 km of the coast, creating an urgent need for accurate spatial data to support climate adaptation and urban planning. However, existing road-network datasets such as Overture adopt a traffic-oriented representation in which multi-lane roads are stored as multiple parallel segments. Coverage: global; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
